title: Greer's 2001 National Press Club whistleblower panel

tellings.quote: Yeah, this was in 2001 and he hosted a panel of whistleblowers

plain: In 2001, a UFO disclosure campaigner named Steven Greer hosted a panel of whistleblowers at the National Press Club, a press venue in Washington DC. The whistleblowers were people claiming inside knowledge of government UFO secrets, and a man named Mark McCandlish is named among them. A researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb mentions the panel in passing, without naming a source, and points to a 2001 disclosure briefing document that went with it.
